rules.title: Broker fees payable only by the party who engaged the broker
rules.requirement: A licensed broker or salesperson may contract solely with either the tenant or the landlord, and any fee must be paid only by the party who originally engaged the broker. A landlord who hires the broker cannot shift the broker's fee to the tenant.
rules.quoted_span: Any fee shall only be paid by the party, lessor or tenant who originally engaged and entered into a contract with the licensed broker or salesperson.
rules.effective_date_note: Text as amended by 2025, 9, Sec. 43 effective August 1, 2025 (see 2025, 9, Sec. 136).
rules.key_value: Broker fee paid only by the party who hired the broker

parsed.doc_summary: MA G.L. c. 112, § 87DDD½ as amended effective Aug 1, 2025: brokers contract with only one side, and the fee is paid only by the party who engaged the broker.
